inherits.scope: Preserve v1 request validation, exact serialized byte measurements, model allowlist, null exact counts, request-hash binding and planning estimates. Inherited code and policy are pinned and remain unchanged.

stage_semantics: Caller must explicitly supply the trusted runtime stage. Missing or unknown stages block. The provider and question IDs cannot select or weaken a stage. Caller must preserve the stage association through reservation and POST.

repair_operating_limit.scope: Exact UTF-8 bytes of the complete prepareDecision serialized body; includes state, all questions, criteria, model and JSON framing.
repair_operating_limit.basis: A v1-admitted 70,510-byte repair request was rejected with HTTP 400 model_input_limit in d069-admission-probe-02. Use a smaller 24,000-byte operating ceiling for the next scoped repair experiment. This number is an engineering choice, not inferred exact tokens, a calibrated acceptance cutoff or a provider-published limit.

known_v1_false_admission.interpretation: One observed false admission. The former 47/47 aggregate historical usage coverage does not establish repair-context acceptance or exact per-question model tokens.

admission_semantics: admit_estimated remains permission to attempt under local assumptions only. Repair must also pass the exact wire-byte operating check. Neither check guarantees model acceptance, decision quality, completed repair or actual billing. A blocked request is not automatically retried or truncated.
request_binding: Keep canonical request SHA-256 and v2 raw-policy SHA-256. The v2 policy includes exact inherited source hashes. Recheck request, policy and trusted stage at the reservation/POST boundary. Passing a v1 policy hash to the v2 API blocks.
